main_text.head: Religio. XXXV.
main_text.p: [woodcut engraving: a winged figure with a crown and a skeleton at her feet]
main_text.l: QVanam sic lacero Vestita incedis amictu?
Cur Vestis tam Vilis? opes contemno caducas.
Quis liber hic? Patris lex Veneranda mei.
Cur nudum pectus? decet hoc Candoris amican
Cur innixa cruci? Crux mihi sola quies.
Cur alata? homines doceo super astra Solare.
Quid docet hoc frenum? mentis cohibere furore
Cur tibi mors premitur? mors quia mortis eg

page.notes: The text is in roman type with some italic words; the verse lines are partly cut off at the right edge. "Vestis", "Vera", "Veneranda" and similar words use V for U as printed in the source's style, left as printed. Last line "amican" and "eg" are cut off by the page edge and may be incomplete. The woodcut is described above and not transcribed.
